thread:
deploy-bot: Release candidate rc-1234 to prod blocked by compliance gate: vulnerability scan reported 1 HIGH, 3 MED, 5 LOW. Failing policy: high >= 1 -> hold. CVE: CVE-2025-3141 in package build-optimizer@1.2.0 (transitive). SBOM: https://artifacts.redwood/rc-1234/sbom.json :warning:
release-mgr-sam: Hmm. How exploitable is that CVE? Any public PoC or active exploitation?
sec-elaine: There's a published PoC (2025-11-02), affects parser component. Attack surface appears limited but still qualifies as HIGH per our vuln-policy. We need to decide: pin, rollback, or exception.
devops-james: Artifact's already in registry. We can pin to build-optimizer@1.1.9 and rebuild the release, but that means rebuild + smoke + canary. ETA ~3h.
anya: Important note: build-optimizer is only used at build time in our toolchain. Runtime SBOM doesn't include it, SBOM flagged it because we include build deps in the aggregate SBOM.
sec-elaine: If it's truly build-time only (not shipped in runtime image), we can consider a temporary exception while we patch build tooling. However legal needs to sign off on exceptions. @legal-bot tagging for review.
legal-bot: Automatic notice: Legal review required for production exceptions. Please attach a brief risk assessment and mitigation plan in the release ticket.
qa-luis: If you decide to pin+rebuild, I can run smoke + regression in ~2.5h and give a canary thumbs in 30-45m after rebuild.
release-mgr-sam: Two options: A) Delay to next change window (tomorrow 04:00 UTC) and rebuild then, or B) Do pin+rebuild now and run a short canary with manual approval. Which do we prefer?
devops-james: I vote pin+rebuild now. Safer than exception; we can keep the release timeline if teams approve.
sec-elaine: I'll approve a limited exception only if you provide runtime SBOM evidence that the package is not included AND add a CI check for runtime-only deps. Exception would expire in 7 days.
anya: Confirmed: runtime SBOM search shows no reference to build-optimizer. Pasting quick check:
```
# sbom/runtime-deps.txt
grep -i "build-optimizer" -n || echo "none"
# -> none
```
release-mgr-sam: OK. Plan: pin to 1.1.9 + rebuild. Devops please proceed; QA to run smoke/regression; canary at 5% for 30m, manual gate to full. I'll update the release ticket with timeline.
devops-james: Starting pin+rebuild now. Will push new artifact and post sha when done.
deploy-bot: Status updated: blocked -> in-progress (manual intervention). Tagging: rc-1234-pin-1.1.9
sec-elaine: Once rebuild artifact is posted, upload the SBOM evidence and I'll draft the exception doc for Legal to sign.
release-mgr-sam: Timeline note: holding for ~3h for rebuild & verification. If we don't get a green rebuild we'll reschedule to the next change window. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
qa-luis: Queuing regression runs now.
anya: Push complete, CI triggered, rebuild started.
devops-james: Rebuild finished. New artifact sha: sha256:abc123def456. Smoke tests passed.
devops-james: Canary started at 5%. Observability hooks enabled.
release-mgr-sam: Monitoring metrics at 15m — no error spike, latency normal. If green at 30m we ramp to 25%.
sec-elaine: Exception draft prepared; will attach runtime-SBOM grep and mitigation steps (CI runtime-dep check + revert plan).
release-mgr-sam: Ramping to 25% now.
deploy-bot: Canary metrics: latency within baseline, error rate unchanged.
release-mgr-sam: Proceeding to full rollout in two steps. Will post when done.
release-mgr-sam: Full rollout complete. Release closed. Adding follow-ups: add CI rule to exclude build-time-only packages from runtime SBOM aggregation, and document exception process in release runbook.
